CVE-2026-16524.title: A command injection flaw in PCP's linux_sockets PMDA allows malic ...
CVE-2026-16524.description:
A command injection flaw in PCP's linux_sockets PMDA allows malicious shell metacharacters via the network.persocket.filter metric.
This failed validation lets attackers execute arbitrary commands as the PMDA user when metrics refresh.

CVE-2026-16526.title: A flaw in the PCP linux_sockets module exposes an unsecured inter ...
CVE-2026-16526.description:
A flaw in the PCP linux_sockets module exposes an unsecured internal connection.
An attacker with initial code execution can exploit this to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary commands as root.

CVE-2026-16527.title: An unauthenticated remote attacker can bypass access controls by  ...
CVE-2026-16527.description: An unauthenticated remote attacker can bypass access controls by sending crafted requests to the PCP pmproxy /store endpoint. This allows the attacker to overwrite any PMDA metric, leading to arbitrary code execution and system takeover.

CVE-2026-16529.title: A signed integer overflow in the PCP __pmGetPDU() function can be ...
CVE-2026-16529.description: A signed integer overflow in the PCP __pmGetPDU() function can be exploited via crafted network packets during PDU processing or SASL negotiation. This permanently blinds the affected daemon, resulting in a total denial of service (DoS) for subsequent packet reads.

CVE-2026-16530.title: A flaw was found in the PCP (Performance Co-Pilot) `pmproxy` serv ...
CVE-2026-16530.description: A flaw was found in the PCP (Performance Co-Pilot) `pmproxy` service. A remote attacker can exploit a vulnerability in the `pmLogLoadInDom()` function by sending a specially crafted request. This bypasses a critical bounds check, which can lead to the `pmproxy` service crashing, causing a Denial of Service (DoS). Additionally, this flaw may enable the leakage of sensitive information from the system's memory.

CVE-2026-16531.description: An unauthenticated remote attacker can exploit a path traversal vulnerability in the PCP pmproxy logger servlet using a crafted hostname. This allows arbitrary file and directory creation, potentially leading to a denial of service.
